title: Does hematologic context improve glycemic prediction of albuminuria? An HbA1c–MCHC transfer test
abstract: In exploratory NHANES 2009–2010 to 2015–2016 transfer (n=4497/4204), adding an HbA1c-by-MCHC spline surface changed weighted log-UACR MSE from 0.794711 to 1.161818, delta +0.367107 (joint PSU-bootstrap 95% [+0.095977,+5.703446]). The registered improvement criterion failed.
